title: Dennis Koshta
description: Software engineer building AI systems, tools, games, and simulations.
intro: I’m a software engineer at Bronco AI in San Francisco. I work on AI systems and tools, and make games, simulations, and websites on the side.
I’m interested in how AI can help us learn, discover, and build. This site is a collection of things I’ve been working on.

selected.description: What keeps an AI agent from taking a harmful shortcut? Experiments on refusal, reasoning, distillation, and multi-agent oversight.
AI-assisted work on the Busy Beaver Challenge: proving whether small Turing machines halt or run forever.
An adaptive learning platform with lessons, practice, feedback, and progress tracking.
